gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anuphan: Stentiga stretches out its spacing with a refined, luxurious hush. Anuphan brings big round lowercase bowls and open curves, so a long run of text moves along without snagging.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-arimo: Stentiga draws refined, luxurious letters with a rounded-wire stroke and tracking opened up wide. Arimo takes over below with a tall mean line and spacious gaps in rounded glyphs, which keeps extended text comfortable.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-athiti: Athiti cuts every line to one width, like sign-shop vinyl. Beneath Stentiga's wide-tracked, luxurious display letters, its high mean line and open s keep the text grounded and approachable.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Generous tracking gives Stentiga a refined, luxurious sweep. Atkinson Hyperlegible brings wide-set s terminals, so paragraphs stay legible and approachable even if its capitals and ascenders feel a touch clipped.

Open counters breathe into the white space, giving the body text an approachable, spaced-out feel. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono sits under Stentiga's laser-cut single-stroke letters, and the two share that stretched-open spacing.

Big washer-sized eyes keep Atkinson Hyperlegible Next friendly on the page. Stentiga's round bowls never thicken or thin, while the body's unlatched rounds keep extended reading light and contemporary.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-biryani: Approachable is Biryani's first impression, with a large clear eye on every e and counters that never clog. Stentiga's refined, luxurious, wide tracking makes that openness the pair's real draw.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-blinker: Luxurious spacing defines Stentiga, its tracking spread out and its crossbars matching its stems. But Blinker does the daily work, with lowercase filling most of the height and apertures that read easily.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-carrois-gothic: Refined and luxurious, Stentiga draws with a marker-nib line. Carrois Gothic, modern and professional, brings a high-set x-height with a generous c opening, so extended text stays easy going.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Every curve ends in a clear opening, and capitals sit nearly level with lowercase. Carrois Gothic SC handles the everyday text, while Stentiga's single-nib, wide-tracked letters bring the refined, luxurious moment.
